ابتلعا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَلَعَا (ibtalaʕā) /ib.ta.la.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# اُبْتُلِعَا (ubtuliʕā) /ub.tu.li.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# اِبْتَلِعَا (ibtaliʕā) /ib.ta.li.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
